# clavis syncs use-connection

<p class="cli-lead">Move a sync onto a shared connection, dropping its own credential</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis syncs use-connection ID [flags]
```

</div>

Point an existing sync at a saved connection, or turn the sync's own credential into a new connection that other syncs can reuse.

## Examples

```sh
clavis syncs use-connection 123e4567 --name "Home Forgejo"
```

## Flags

</dl>
